sn22.55:1.3: no cassaṃ no ca me siyā na bhavissati na me bhavissatīti
sn22.55:1.4: evaṃ vimuccamāno bhikkhu chindeyya orambhāgiyāni saññojanānīti.
sn22.55:1.5: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn22.55:1.6: yathākathaṃ pana bhante no cassaṃ no ca me siyā na bhavissati na me bhavissatīti
sn22.55:1.7: evaṃ vimuccamāno bhikkhu chindeyya orambhāgiyāni saññojanānīti.
sn22.55:2.1: idha bhikkhu assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī …pe…
sn22.55:2.2: sappurisadhamme avinīto rūpaṃ attato samanupassati rūpavanta vā attānaṃ attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.55:2.6: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn22.55:3.1: so aniccaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn22.55:3.2: aniccaṃ vedanaṃ aniccā vedanāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn22.55:3.3: aniccaṃ saññaṃ aniccā saññāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn22.55:3.4: anicce saṅkhāre aniccā saṅkhārāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn22.55:3.5: aniccaṃ viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.55:4.1: dukkhaṃ rūpaṃ dukkhaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn22.55:4.5: dukkhaṃ viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.55:5.1: anattaṃ rūpaṃ anattaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn22.55:5.5: anattaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.55:6.1: saṅkhataṃ rūpaṃ saṅkhataṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn22.55:6.5: saṅkhataṃ viññāṇaṃ saṅkhataṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn22.55:7.1: sutavā ca kho bhikkhu ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto
sn22.55:8.1: so aniccaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
sn22.55:8.5: aniccaṃ viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.55:8.8: saṅkhataṃ rūpaṃ …pe… saṅkhataṃ viññāṇaṃ saṅkhataṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.55:9.1: so rūpassa vibhavā vedanāya vibhavā saññāya vibhavā saṅkhārānaṃ vibhavā viññāṇassa vibhavā. evaṃ kho bhikkhu
sn22.55:9.2: no cassaṃ no ca me siyā na bhavissati na me bhavissatīti
sn22.55:9.3: evaṃ vimuccamāno bhikkhu chindeyya orambhāgiyāni saññojanānīti.
sn22.55:9.4: evaṃ vimuccamāno bhante bhikkhu chindeyya orambhāgiyāni saññojanāni.
sn22.55:10.1: kathaṃ pana bhante jānato kathaṃ passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hotīti.
sn22.55:10.2: idha bhikkhu assutavā puthujjano …pe… atasitāye ṭhāne tāsaṃ āpajjati.
sn22.55:10.4: no cassaṃ no ca me siyā na bhavissati na me bhavissatīti.
sn22.55:11.1: sutavā ca kho bhikkhu ariyasāvako …pe… atasitāye ṭhāne na tāsaṃ āpajjati.
sn22.55:11.2: na heso bhikkhu tāso sutavato ariyasāvakassa
sn22.55:11.3: no cassaṃ no ca me siyā na bhavissati na me bhavissatīti.
sn22.55:11.4: rūpūpāyaṃ vā bhikkhu viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya rūpārammaṇaṃ rūpappatiṭṭhaṃ nandūpasevanaṃ vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
sn22.55:11.7: saṅkhārūpāyaṃ vā bhikkhu viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya saṅkhārārammaṇaṃ saṅkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nandūpasevanaṃ vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
sn22.55:12.2: ahamaññatra rūpā aññatra vedanāya aññatra saññāya aññatra saṅkhārehi viññāṇassa āgatiṃ vā gatiṃ vā cutiṃ vā upapattiṃ vā vuḍḍhiṃ vā virūḷhiṃ vā vepullaṃ vā paññapessāmīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn22.55:13.1: rūpadhātuyā ce bhikkhu bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti rāgassa pahānā vocchijjatārammaṇaṃ patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.
sn22.55:13.5: viññāṇadhātuyā ce bhikkhu bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti rāgassa pahānā vocchijjatārammaṇaṃ patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.
sn22.55:13.7: vimuttattā ṭhitaṃ ṭhitattā santusitaṃ santusitattā na paritassati aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati.
sn22.55:13.9: evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evaṃ passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hotīti.
